description: Breaking changes, removed or renamed APIs, config and default changes, packages that split off, deprecations, and the advisories fixed, between the version a project uses and the one to move to. Sources: changelogs and GitHub release notes for the versions in between, migration guides when a major is crossed, and (npm) a diff of the exported .d.ts API. Call it before upgrading across a major, when a SECURITY NOTICE recommends a new major, or to fix a Dependabot PR. Without "to" it uses the version pinright recommends.

ecosystem.description: npm, pypi, cargo, go, maven, nuget or rubygems.

from.description: Version the project uses now, e.g. "15.5.28" (a range like "4.x" picks its newest release).

libraryId.description: Id like "npm:next" or "pypi:langchain" (a version in it is used as "from").

package.description: Package name, with ecosystem, instead of libraryId.

query.description: What you are changing, e.g. "middleware auth redirect"; ranks entries about it first.

to.description: Version to move to. Default: the recommended safe version.

tokens.description: Approximate size of the answer in tokens (default 5000).

name: upgrade-guide
title: What changes between two versions
